briefing: Tech stocks led the market today, with the NASDAQ up 1.5% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%. We have $546 in cash and 3 open slots, and past lessons say to put cash to work on strong up days, so we are buying GOOGL and, if cash allows, INTC. Both have full signal confirmation and are not yet overbought. We are keeping all current positions and letting the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules handle exits.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, higher-growth assets like tech stocks, which is why the NASDAQ rose more than the S&P 500 today. On days like this, momentum strategies tend to work better, so it is a sensible time to spend cash that has been waiting on the sidelines.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On）市況，是指投資者信心增強，願意把資金投向科技股等較高風險、較高增長的資產，這正是今日納指跑贏標普500的原因。在這類市況下，動能策略往往較為奏效，因此是動用場邊閒置資金入市的合適時機。

market_education.summary_en: Investors were willing to take on more risk today, and tech-heavy stocks rose about twice as much as the broader S&P 500. Many large-cap tech and semiconductor names, including AMZN, GOOGL, INTC and WDC, rose on heavy trading volume, which suggests big institutional investors were buying rather than just a few small traders. No specific news headlines were available today, so this explanation is based only on price, volume and momentum data.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場風險胃納明顯回升，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數升幅約為標普500指數的兩倍。AMZN、GOOGL、INTC及WDC等大型科技及半導體股均放量上揚，反映資金流入並非零星散戶炒作，而是機構投資者積極入市。由於今日未有具體新聞標題可供引用，以上分析僅根據股價、成交量及動能數據作出判斷。

trades.reasoning: GOOGL shows all four buy signals (MACD crossover, a rising histogram, price above its 20-day average, and a volume surge), and its RSI of 64.5 still leaves room to rise before it counts as overbought.
INTC also shows all four signals, and its RSI of 62.7 is moderate, so it is a lower-priced backup if there is cash left after GOOGL.
